findings.title: SQL Injection - Boolean-Blind on search.php (CTF Flag Extracted)
findings.description: Double-quote SQL injection in the 'username' POST parameter of search.php. A keyword-based WAF filter blocks space-delimited SQL keywords, but is bypassed by replacing spaces with /**/ MySQL comment blocks. Boolean-blind extraction via &&/ascii()/mid() functions extracted the admin plaintext password.
findings.evidence:
1. Injection confirmed: admin"# returns 'User exists: admin'
2. Filter bypass: space+keyword+space is blocked, but keyword without spaces passes
3. Boolean blind: admin"/**/&&/**/ascii(mid(password,1,1))>X# reveals chars
4. Admin password extracted: ThisIsBestPassword
5. Login successful: flag{787d5a7f-ec79-4620-99c5-17c50dced80a}

reproduction.expected: Returns 'User exists: admin' if condition true, 'No results' if false
